concepts.definition: the exchange of goods and services between buyers and sellers
a trader who buys goods in large quantities from producers and resells them mainly to retailers
a trader who sells goods or services in relatively small quantities directly to final consumers
an arrangement that transfers specified financial risks to an insurer in return for a premium
the business of accepting deposits, facilitating payments, and providing financial services and credit
the movement of people and goods from one location to another to support production and exchange
the safe storage of goods until they are needed for distribution, sale, or production
paid non-personal communication used to inform or persuade a target audience about goods, services, or ideas
the buying and selling of goods or services through electronic networks, especially the internet
the process of identifying an opportunity and organizing resources to create and manage a venture while bearing risk
